description: Searches holiday packages (flight + hotel) to one destination country. Returns packages with hotel name, stars, guest rating, board, departure date and airports, total and per-person price, and a link to book on the brand's website. Filters: dates, nights, travellers, departure airport, price, stars, board and region (regionCode from get_regions of the same country, countryCode from get_countries); sorting by popularity, price, rating or stars; cursor pagination. Only countryCode is required (defaults: departures in the next 2 months, 7 nights, 2 adults). Read-only.

childrenAges.description: Ages of children (optional, empty array if no children)

countryCode.description: Two-letter destination country code (e.g. 'ES' for Spain, 'GR' for Greece, 'TR' for Turkey, 'EG' for Egypt), as listed by get_countries.

cursor.description: Cursor for pagination (from previous response's nextCursor)

dateFrom.description: Earliest departure, YYYY-MM-DD (optional, defaults to tomorrow). With dateTo, the window the whole trip must fit in.

dateTo.description: Latest return date, YYYY-MM-DD (optional, defaults to 2 months from now). At least the minimum nights after dateFrom; a shorter window is rejected.

departureAirport.description: Departure airport IATA code (e.g. 'WAW' or 'KTW' on eSky, 'MAN' or 'LGW' on Thomas Cook UK). Omitted = all available departure airports.

limit.description: Number of results to return (default 6, max 30)

maxPrice.description: Maximum price in the local currency (optional)

minPrice.description: Minimum price in the local currency (optional)

nightsMax.description: Maximum number of nights of a flexible range (optional, together with nightsMin). When set, 'nights' is ignored.

nightsMin.description: Minimum number of nights of a flexible range (optional, together with nightsMax). When set, 'nights' is ignored.

regionCode.description: Optional region or city code from get_regions for the same countryCode (e.g. 're-ACA'); a code of another country is rejected. Narrows the search.

sortBy.description: Sort results by: 'popularity' (default, most booked first), 'price', 'rating', or 'stars'.

sortOrder.description: Sort order: 'asc' (ascending) or 'desc' (descending). Default depends on sort type.

name: search_packages
title: Search holiday packages
